values.en: The map $(t,x)\mapsto(t,f_0(x))$ is continuous. Its composite with $G$ has endpoints $g_0\circ f_0$ and $g_1\circ f_0$; equivalently it is the composition of $G$ with the constant homotopy of $f_0$.
values.zh-CN: $(t,x)\mapsto(t,f_0(x))$ 连续，与 $G$ 复合后的端点为 $g_0\circ f_0$ 与 $g_1\circ f_0$；等价地，这是 $G$ 与 $f_0$ 的恒等同伦的复合。
